behaviors.observed_source: InputDispatcher applies all preprocessors, handles representation or first matching editing-context handler, then runs postprocessors. Handler payload emission and postprocessing are separate stages; there is no generic try/finally around the shown sequence.
behaviors.unresolved_guarantee: Commit/ack guarantee and effects of partial preprocessor/handler/postprocessor failures unresolved.

behaviors.observed_source: EditingContextEventProcessor submits dispatcher work then waits on Future.get, logs InterruptedException/ExecutionException, returns payloadSink Mono; executor shutdown path returns Mono.empty.
behaviors.unresolved_guarantee: If a payload was emitted before a later failure, actual client observation versus durable commit requires end-to-end qualification; no loss/atomicity claim invented.

behaviors.observed_source: ResourceToDocumentService save/conversion catches IllegalArgumentException/IOException and returns Optional.empty. Persistence flatMaps successful conversions and then calls updateDocuments.
behaviors.unresolved_guarantee: Skipped conversion versus retained/removed stored document semantics under actual failure/transaction need original runtime evidence.

behaviors.observed_source: Persistence is annotated transactional and operates through semantic aggregate/repository services; source declaration graph retains DB migrations.
behaviors.unresolved_guarantee: Annotation is not crash/rollback/DB-commit evidence; actual transaction manager, exception handling, event timing, durable-write boundary and retry/idempotency unqualified.

behaviors.observed_source: Search validates editing-context UUID, looks up semantic data, creates a new editing domain/context and loads it under read-only transaction annotations.
behaviors.unresolved_guarantee: Actual resource/parser/identity/library migration reload integrity and corrupted/truncated/incompatible data handling open.

behaviors.observed_source: Event processor disposal completes/disposes change stream, shuts executor, disposes representation registry/context and completes payload sink; context unloads resources/disposes recorder/factory.
behaviors.unresolved_guarantee: Pending input cancellation/drain/interruption/subscription cleanup and restart outcomes open.

behaviors.observed_source: Backend input-ID maps and client sessionStorage are separate from persisted document storage.
behaviors.unresolved_guarantee: No restart-history, journal, replay or cross-client conflict guarantee established by this source inventory.

behaviors.observed_source: Native workflow local snapshot/fsync/no-clobber behavior remains bounded MODEL/UI evidence.
behaviors.unresolved_guarantee: It does not establish DB, process crash, media loss, corrupt-state recovery or original full application acceptance.

behaviors.observed_source: Backup/restore integrity, migration upgrade/rollback, independent retained data and crossproject isolation remain required source/runtime obligations.
behaviors.unresolved_guarantee: No backup deletion, filesystem repair, package/service change, production mutation or fault injection authorized by this inventory.
